objective: EXAMPLE — add a missing white-BG cake packshot to the White BG Powder set so it matches its 23+ siblings exactly apart from the printed name and dose. Copy this file, swap the reference to a donor packshot from the SAME spectrum category as the new product, and set the name/dose in the contract.

assets.instructions: Reference 1: the approved in-set packshot this image must match. Same endocrine (pink) category, so its cap, accent bar and dose colour are already correct and must be preserved unchanged. Copy the vial, glass, cap, crimp collar, powder, label layout, typography, lighting, framing and pure-white background from it exactly; change only the printed product name and dose.

creative.concept: A catalogue packshot that joins an existing, already-approved set. This is a reproduction task, not a design task: the value is in being identical to reference 1, not in being interesting.
creative.scene: A single NuLumin peptide vial standing upright and centred on a pure solid white (#FFFFFF) seamless background, edge to edge, with nothing else in the frame. Framing, vial scale and vial position match reference 1.
creative.action: Reproduce reference 1 and change only the printed product name (to "Oxytocin") and the printed dose (to "5mg").
creative.camera: Straight-on product view at the same height, distance and angle as reference 1. The vial's label faces the camera and is tack-sharp.
creative.lighting: The same soft, even, cool-neutral white studio light as reference 1. The label is evenly exposed and fully legible; no cast shadow on the background.
creative.style: Photoreal studio packshot photography, crisp and clinical. Not a 3D render, not a stylised illustration.
creative.contract:
REPRODUCE REFERENCE 1 EXACTLY. Reference 1 is an approved NuLumin Bio-Sciences catalogue packshot from the set this image must join, so the output has to be indistinguishable from it apart from the two changes listed below. Reproduce identically: the same clear glass vial with the same exact shape, proportions, width, height and position in the frame; the same coloured flip cap and the same brushed-silver crimp collar beneath it; the same soft neutral cool-white studio lighting with the same specular highlights and glass refraction; the same generous mound of FINE, SOFT, GRANULAR pure-white lyophilised peptide powder settled at the base of the vial and clearly visible through the glass below the label (fine loose granular powder with a soft gently-mounded top — never a cracked or fractured hard cake, never liquid, never an empty vial); and the same white label with the same layout, the same typography, the same proportions and the same position on the glass: the "NuLumin  BIO-SCIENCES" logo lockup at the top left with its horizontal rule beneath the wordmark, the vertical coloured accent bar down the left edge of the label, the large italic serif product name, the dose line beneath it, the small thin-ruled "For Research Use / Not for Human Consumption" box at the top right, and the small "Manufactured by NuLumin" footer line at the bottom.

CHANGE ONLY THESE THREE THINGS:
1. The product NAME — the large italic serif line — must read EXACTLY "Oxytocin", spelled exactly that way and nothing else. It stays CRISP SOLID BLACK in the same italic serif face at the same weight as reference 1. Set it at a size that fits entirely inside the label's clear area — it must never touch, overlap or run underneath the research-use box at the top right, and never run past the label's left or right edge. Reduce its size if that is what it takes to fit.
2. The DOSE line directly beneath the name must read EXACTLY "5mg".
3. THE TAGLINE: the small tracked-out capitals beneath the "NuLumin" wordmark and its horizontal rule must read EXACTLY "BIO-SCIENCES" — WITH the hyphen between "BIO" and "SCIENCES". Reference 1 renders it without the hyphen; that is a known error in the reference and it must be corrected here. Keep the same size, the same wide letter-spacing, the same weight and the same position — the only difference is that the hyphen is present.

THE ACCENT COLOUR DOES NOT CHANGE. The flip cap, the vertical accent bar and the dose text keep the EXACT same colour as reference 1 — same hue, same saturation, same softness. Do not brighten it, do not saturate it, do not shift or replace it. The product name is never coloured; only the dose is coloured.

EVERYTHING ELSE IS PIXEL-IDENTICAL to reference 1: the "NuLumin" wordmark itself, the horizontal rule, "BIO-SCIENCES", the research-use box and its fine print, the footer line, the accent bar, the glass, the cap, the crimp collar, the powder, the lighting and the framing.

THE BACKGROUND IS PURE SOLID WHITE (#FFFFFF) — completely plain and seamless, edge to edge. No gradient, no vignette, no grey, no cast shadow, no floor, no surface, no reflection. The vial stands upright and centred, and the WHOLE vial from the top of the cap to the base of the glass sits inside the frame, never cropped.

ALL POWDER IS INSIDE THE VIAL. There is no spilled powder, no pile or mound of powder on the background, no scattering, no dust, and no second object anywhere in the frame.
mustInclude: the whole vial, cap to base, inside the frame on a pure white background
fine granular pure-white lyophilised powder filling the base of the vial, inside the glass
the product name reading exactly "Oxytocin" in solid black italic serif, fitting inside the label
the cap, accent bar and dose in the same colour as reference 1
the "NuLumin BIO-SCIENCES" lockup, the research-use box and the "Manufactured by NuLumin" footer reproduced exactly
the tagline reading exactly "BIO-SCIENCES", with the hyphen present
mustAvoid: a coloured product name — only the dose is coloured
name text touching, overlapping or running underneath the research-use box
spilled powder, a powder pile, dust or any second object on the background
an empty vial, a cracked or fractured cake, or liquid contents
a cast shadow, floor, tabletop, grey background, gradient or vignette
re-lettered, re-typeset, restyled or misspelled logo, research box or footer text
a brighter, more saturated, or different accent colour than reference 1
any added text, watermark or second vial

requiredDisclosures: For Research Use Only. Not for Human Consumption.
compliance.note: The RUO line is the printed label box, reproduced from the approved reference packshot — not new copy. No claims are made in this asset.
